name: National Dex Expansion (Gen 3-9: Hoenn to Paldea)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Expands the playable Pokédex to #1025 with 419 Gen 3-9 families, Dual Shinies (Classic + Alt Palette), 72 clean-named attacks, and 24 Ultimates.
description: Complete Gen 3 through Gen 9 character and moveset expansion covering Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea (#252-#1025). Adds 419 playable base evolution families, 774 species with animated sprites, official shiny palettes mapped to Classic Shiny plus bespoke alternative-palette Shiny sprites for every single Gen 3-9 Pokémon, 72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks across all 18 types with clean attack names, and 24 custom signature Ultimates. Pure Pokémon and attacks pack with zero bundled levels; pair with Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack for regional maps.
highlights: Expands the Pokédex cap from #251 to #1025 across all 7 Gen 3-9 regions (419 playable families, 774 species)
Dual Shinies for all 774 Gen 3-9 Pokémon: official shiny colors as Classic Shiny + custom alternative-palette sprites as Shiny
72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks across all 18 types with clean canonical attack names rendered via PokéBonk's native GPU VFX engine
24 custom Ultimates (Rayquaza, Lucario, Garchomp, Greninja, Zacian, Koraidon, Miraidon, Raging Bolt, Terapagos, and more)
Characters start locked by default for progression, with per-generation unlock tools in Unbound Settings
